text:
sanjay: heads-up, seeing a large KV prefix-cache miss spike at 10:12 UTC, backend QPS doubled and a few p99s hit. routing CPU climbed.
chloe: OMG, timeline? did this follow the kernel-selector tweak we rolled last night?
dave: looks correlated — deploy-bot shows rollout of kernel-heuristic v2 at 09:58.
perf-bot: perf alert: prefix-kv-hit-rate dropped from 92% -> 54% for chat-route-1 between 10:10-10:20. tail latency +3x.
sanjay: logs show many requests with slightly different prefix tokens (subtokenization drift). cache keying uses raw tokenized prefix + model-version.
lina: that tokenizer drift could change keys even for semantically same prefixes. Were we relying on normalized prefix hashing? 
chloe: we switched to hash(prefix_bytes) instead of normalized-text hash in v2 to speed key calc; maybe that made cache fragmentation worse.
dave: also batching heuristic changed: longer sequence favoring grouped kernels -> fewer opportunities for prefix cache warmups on short prefix routes.
sanjay: result: cold-prefixes hit backend more often -> backend overloaded -> some cache service instances started GC thrashing.
perf-bot: profile snippet (10:15):
```
95% CPU on routing-worker
top stacks: build-cache-key -> kernel-select -> serialize_request
KV cache hit_rate=0.54 miss_qps=3400 -> backend_qps=6800
```
chloe: so two interacting regressions: keying change + batch/kernelselection changed runtime behavior. Combined increased cardinality of cache keys and reduced reuse.
lina: confirmed with sampling: same user prompt tokenization changed keys 1 in 6 requests post-deploy.
dave: mitigation options: revert kernel-heuristic change, revert keying change, emergency throttle miss-QPS, or emergency disable prefix caching for that route.
sanjay: I disabled prefix caching for chat-route-1 at 10:22 (emergency). Backend QPS down to baseline in ~30s, p99 dropped.
chloe: good call. Can we re-enable partial warmup? full disable kills cost savings but buys stability.
perf-bot: disable event: deploy-bot records config flip chat-route-1.prefix_cache=false @10:22 by sanjay
sanjay: post-disable numbers (10:30): backend_qps normalized, routing CPU back to 60%.
dave: next steps: reproduce locally with tokenizer variants; add unit test for key-equivalence across tokenizers; change keying to normalized-text hash + model-version to reduce fragmentation.
lina: also want a warmup job: after deploy, spike a small set of canonical prefixes to populate caches across shards (configurable TTL). That mitigates warm restarts and rollout ripples.
chloe: and update batching heuristics so short-prefix routes don't get folded into long-seq kernels until cache-warmup window completes.
dave: for short term: revert keying change in canary and test hit-rate.
sanjay: assigning: dave -> revert keying change in canary + perf run, chloe -> design warmup job + rollout gating, lina -> tokenizer test & hash equivalence checks.
perf-bot: noted. Create perf run: prefix-hit-rate test 100k synthetic requests across tokenization variants.
dave: timeline: revert canary today, run perf tests, if hit-rate returns -> staged re-enable with warmup job. If not, keep prefix cache disabled for chat-route-1 until fix.
sanjay: postmortem checklist: root cause (key calc change + kernel selection interaction), detection (perf alert), mitigation (emergency disable), long-term (warmup + key normalization + rollout policy).
chloe: add monitoring: an alert that correlates hit-rate drop + backend_qps increase so we can auto-throttle or flip config earlier.
lina: will draft RFC for keying best-practices; include stable normalization and canonicalization steps.
sanjay: FYI to oncall teams: if you see similar miss surges, check recent kernel/heuristic or keying deploys and consider emergency disable of prefix-cache per-route. @here :warning:
dave: logging note: add sampled tokenized-prefix to perf traces (scrubbed) to make drift detection easier.
chloe: thanks everyone. we should capture this in incidents/ later.
perf-bot: follow-up task created: PERF-4523 "prefix cache key normalization & warmup".
deploy-bot: rollback/flip actions and timestamps recorded in deploy log.
sanjay: closing thread for now, will open postmortem after RCA. :thumbsup:
